overview_description.description: Netsmart Technologies, Inc. is a supplier of on demand and enterprise-wide software solutions to health and human services providers and payers nationwide. Netsmart's customers include mental health and substance abuse treatment providers, private and small group behavioral health practices, psychiatric hospitals, public health agencies, and managed care organizations. Netsmart software is designed for a variety of operating systems, hardware platforms, and mobile devices.
